avis.texte: I really wanted to love this SPF, but unfortunately the product I received expires in April 2026, which is the same month I purchased it.

This reminds me of La Roche Posay's AOX 50 serum, but I prefer this one because it does not contain oxybenzone, and the packaging is more handy for travel. The texture is fluid without being unduly runny, and it spreads easily without dragging. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. I have combination skin. This sunscreen is lightweight enough for my T-zone and neck, but I always have use blotting powder on my T-zone, no matter what. It is not moisturizing enough to keep from flaking around my drier cheeks and mouth, so I layer it over moisturizer for cooler weather (I have a heavier daily sunscreen for harsh Northeast winter weather). The texture feels more like serum than sunscreen, so it washes off easily at the end of the day. I'm glad I found this.

avis.titre: Not perfect but worth a try
avis.texte: As someone who spends a lot on SPF 50 sunscreens, trying to find 1 that doesn't burn your eyes, I'll say this one is good option, with the small caveat that you should wait a few minutes until you put on makeup around your eyes and blend it.

avis.titre: New Holy Grail with No White Cast
avis.texte: Absolutely LOVE this sunscreen. Great SPF protection and a wonderful, kind of watery texture that blends right in with my other skincare without pilling. This sunscreen also leaves a nice glow, without looking too shiny or oily.

Honestly, I am shook over the results. I've used Skinceuticals, Naturium, etc……this one gives moisture, darkens light spots quickly, just the right glow on combo skin during heat & humidity, beautifully layers under makeup, doesnt irritate eyes when used carefully. Been using for 2 weeks and the compliments keep coming! Not kidding, feel as though this has taken 5-10 years off my skin. Wore to beach vacay and NO sunburn!

This is the best SPF 60 facial moisturizer that I have tried. I am outside quite a bit, and this is the second best thing to a hat. Please note that any SPF 60 is going to read slightly opaque, even if it is a super light formula like this one. Still best in it's category; I haven't seen protection like this in such a light formula until now.

The hardest thing about finding a good sunscreen is finding a formula that works well under my makeup. This sunscreen goes on effortlessly and doesn't leave a white cast behind. Makeup applies perfectly over it without pilling up or separating. And I feel like my skin is glowing more and I've seen a reduction in my fine lines. Excellent product.

The sunscreen feels really moisturizing on my skin. It doesn't have chemical scent, and absorbs quickly. No white cast. It claims to have SPF60, which is really high for a daily sunscreen so I trust that it can protect me from skin cancer

LOVE this product! I have very dry skin and struggle to find products that are nourishing to my skin. I love that this is a large size product at a comparable price point as my current sunscreen that is a much smaller container. This is very hydrating and I love that my skin is protected without a heavy cream or whitecast. Highly recommended!
I really loved this sunscreen. It didn't clog my pores and went on evenly. It also didn't have a potent smell like most do.

This sunscreen is so lightweight and not at all greasy. Right after I put it on, it feels like I'm not wearing anything. Most sunscreens feel heavy and like they're actively clogging my pores. This one is awesome.
I have been mixing with foundation, blends well Doesn't cause breakouts and coverage is smooth

For decades, I've been hearing about how important it is to wear sunscreen on your face and until recently when I started seeing dark spots from the sun, didn't believe it. I am so thankful for the sunscreen and excited to prevent any future damage to my skin. There's no weird smell and it goes on seamlessly.

avis.titre: Light weight and does a good job!
avis.texte: I would say that this product is all about keeping it simple. It is a light weight moisturizer, no fragrance, very absorbent and has a nice pump feature. It works really well! I love how absolutely light weight it is! It protects my skin very well from the sun and has a good amount of spf. The reason it's not 5 stars is because I feel like I can find other moisturizers that do the same thing very well. There is nothing that is quite frankly leaping off the page for this product. But I do consider it reliable! Sturdy product. Good product if your looking for something kinda simpler.
Very light and has a good coverage, would definitely buy again.
This product is super lightweight and perfect for everyday. Does not leave a noticeable white cast on me. The smell is not over powering.

I love this product! This SPF 60 sunscreen is light, easy to apply, and absorbs completely. My skin doesn't feel heavy or waxy like a lot of sunscreens feel. I would definitely recommend this product!

This sunscreen is higher than 50 so yes for me. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue, which is hard to find in high-SPF sunscreens. I especially appreciate how it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin and layers well under my makeup. It has not caused any irritation or breakouts on my skin so that's a plus for me.

I got this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program and this review is based on that sample. This sunscreen is exceptional, leaving my skin exquisitely soft and hydrated without any stickiness or greasiness, and it layers perfectly under makeup. The serum is lightweight and fragrance-free, absorbing swiftly without residue, causing no irritation even on sensitive areas. After a couple of weeks, my skin appears noticeably softer and more even. It's an outstanding vitamin C serum that is both potent and gentle.

Thanks to Vichy I was able to try a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review! I really liked this sunscreen! It doesn't have the traditional "sunscreen" scent, it blends super easily and is a great SPF level (60).
Great addition to any skincare routine. Melts into skin easily without any residue or weird look or feel - so easy to include as part of a routine. Seems to provide good sun protection too.

avis.titre: Great everyday sunscreen for oily skin
avis.texte: This is a light and non-oily sunscreen that I have been loving. The consistency is watery and smooth. This has no white cast and still feels hydrating. New daily go to suncreen.

I put this on in the morning before leaving the house and love the feel of it on my skin. It's thick enough to feel like a light lotion but doesn't feel heavy on my skin. Unfortunately, just like another product from this brand, I had an adverse reaction to it. Not sure what is in both of the products that caused it but I won't be using this one. As far as the product goes, I did appreciate the texture and the scent - it wasn't super strong. I also liked the bottle and the pump dispenser delivering the right amount. It's just not for me.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is a very high spf, so it's going to be excellent for protecting your skin from damage from the sun, especially in comparison to the more common lower spf lotions generally marketed for your face. Unfortunately I found it to be a bit sticky and uncomfortable on my skin when worn alone as I don't wear foundation and powder. It also contains an active sunscreen ingredient that irritates my eyes so it's not the best option for use on my face. I do enjoy it, though, as protection for my neck and chest.

so i was really excited when i saw that vichy gifted me this daily sunscreen because i had just received a vitamin c serum and you can't wear one without another. i loved that it didn't have that sunscreen smell that most spfs have and that it didn't leave a white cast. it also absorbs really nicely and gives a surprisingly amount of moisture for a spf. seriously, you can easily wear it with or without a moisturizer on top depending on the day. i tried it for a week and was content with it everytime i applied it on. the only problem is that it gave me blackheads. at first i wasn't sure if it was a coincidence or not, but i almost never get blackheads on my cheeks, chin, and forehead and this all happened in the week that i was using this product. i stopped using this product and the random blackheads stopped so im sure it was indeed the cause of it. thankfully i am an esthetician so i easily got them out without a problem. other than that issue i would've loved this product and rebought it

This sunscreen had a perfect lightweight texture and felt really good on my skin. I didn't have any kind of strange pilling underneath make up and didn't notice any heavy fragrance. It was easily spreadable and didn't leave my face feeling greasy.

This stuff is perfect, lightweight, quick absorbing, little amount goes a long way, so so so good! The only thing I'm not a fan of is how often you're supposed to reapply - but it lays so well under my make up!

avis.titre: Love it but a little sticky
avis.texte: I received this spf for free in exchange for an honest review. It plays well with the Vichy LiftActiv 16% vitamin c that I also reviewed. I am an avid SPF girl and use it religiously every day and re-apply throughout the day. This is a beautiful sunscreen. It blends in well, leaving no white cast. It has a slight smell but isn't overpowering. I took away a star because it leaves my skin feeling sticky. Maybe the formulation is better for drier complexions but I didn't like the way my skin looks/feels hours after application.

Wow I'm so happy to have found this product. I signed up to try this sunscreen and was amazed not only how well it worked but also the silky non greasy texture. Smells fresh and lasts. Sun protection is so important and this is a product I won't leave home without. Having 60 spf along with everything else seals the deal

I am very picky when it comes to sunscreens. If I don't like the texture or how it spreads, I won't ever use it. I hate it when sunscreens feel heavy or leave a white cast, but not with this one. It blends in seamlessly, even on my combination skin, leaving it feeling hydrated and fresh. It is slightly thicker than my favorite face sunscreen but still thin enough that it doesn't bother me. With a high SPF of 60, I feel confident that my skin is well-protected against UV rays, especially here where I live in Southern California. I would like this sunscreen even better if it was a mineral sunscreen. I don't think chemical sunscreens are bad but I've been lately trying to switch to more natural alternatives so that would make me get it again. In the end I fully trust European sunscreen brands as they are more advanced than the ones you can find here in the United States. The best part about this sunscreen though? The formula is enriched with Hyaluronic acid, Peptides, and Vitamin C… love it when you can skip some other steps in the morning because it has 4 in 1!

While there has been little sun for using a sunsxreen, I did finsd that some days it was good to have a sunsreen like this one. It applied very easily and while I though it might be too heavy, I found the consistency was better than most.

This applies like skincare and is easy to layer with other products. It was not thick and did not leave a white cast. The SPF is pretty high which is nice; I will be taking this on vacation to layer under makeup.

As a 33-year-old mom, I'm thrilled to find a sunscreen that doesn't turn me into a ghost! This goes on light, absorbs fast, and keeps my face from looking like a powdered donut. My skin feels fresher, a bit glowier, and—dare I say—slightly less tired than I am. Plus, it's packed with Hyaluronic acid and Vitamin C, so I feel like I'm at least attempting to age gracefully. This one's a keeper!

Thanks to buzzagent for sending the capital soleil UV age daily spf 60 to try! The sunscreen went on so smooth and soaking in so quickly. It does have a stronger sunscreen smell but dissipates quickly. No sticky or tacky feeling after! Can't wait to add this to my daily routine.

avis.titre: Solid product, will continue to use
avis.texte: Thank you to Vichy, for gifting me the Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60 through BzzAgent's sampling program! I enjoyed the formula. It is nice and light, has a silky feel, and my sometimes sensitive skin had no reactions. I didn't notice a white cast, or the smell, that often accompanies sunscreens. (Even with an SPF of 60!!!) So far, so good. I will continue to use this one for sure.

I received this product in return for an honest review. This sunscreen is relatively lightweight and easy to apply - feels like a light/medium moisturizer. However when it dries, it would always keep pilling for me. I'll finish up the bottle at home but probably won't repurchase

avis.titre: The best sunscreen i ever used
avis.texte: Vichy Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60 is one of the best sunscreens I've tried! It offers high SPF protection while feeling incredibly lightweight on the skin. It doesn't leave any greasy or white residue, making it perfect to wear under makeup. I love that it also has anti-aging benefits, helping to prevent sun damage and fine lines. The formula includes antioxidants like vitamin E, which gives it a boost for skin health. It's also non-comedogenic, so it doesn't clog pores, which is great for sensitive or acne-prone skin. Highly recommend for daily sun protection!

avis.titre: I love Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60
avis.texte: I was asked to try Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF, so I said sure. When I received it I began using it in my morning routine the next morning. On first use, I applied Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60 as the last step of my skin care routine before applying my foundation. The feel of the sunscreen was did not leave my skin feeling greasy but rather my skin felt hydrated.There was satisfaction in knowing that while I was in the sun going about my day I was protected from the sun's UVs which I need being from the South where the weather can be intensely hot and sunny. I loved this product so much that I even applied it to my hands so they were protected too.
Perfect for dry, acne-prone skin. No problems with pilling, flaking, or white cast at all. Would highly recommend!
From someone who never used sunscreen to now being obsessed with, I have to say this is the absolute best!
The spray applicator is a game-changer. I appreciate the product's light texture, lack of residue, and high SPF, making it perfect for daily use.

I really like the packaging. It is very easy to dispense the right amount of sunscreen on my face thanks to the nice pump. I apply it every day even when it's cold because it makes my skin looks super healthy (glass skin) without the white cast. I recommend 100%.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked this smooth
avis.texte: I use this product every morning. After a couple of days I already noticed how much smoother and healthier my skin started looking. This product also does not leave a white cast! It leaves my skin looking and feeling moisturized.

I received this product as a free sample from Bzz agent. First I love the fact that it is a spray applicator! The fact that I don't have to put it on my hands first then rub it on my face is a win. The product is lightweight and does not leave a white cast. I have yet to test it under makeup but expect for it to hold well as well as no issues when reapplying. I like the fact that it has a high SPF coverage and look forward to continue using it.

Thank you Vichy Laboratories for the free sample of Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60. This product has left my skin feeling moisturized and smooth. I like having a moisturizer that is also a sunscreen. This product does not feel heavy on my face and absorbs well.

I received this product free in exchange for a review. I love this SPF from the bottle to the actual product. The pump bottle is so convenient. I love that the sunscreen does not leave a white cast and is not thick. I live in Phoenix so this is a daily must product!

I received the Vichy Laboratories Capital Soleil UV-Age Daily Sunscreen Face 60 in exchange for an honest review. I like this sunscreen because it is thinner than most, easy to spread and soaks in nicely. It does not have a distinct scent. The expiration date is also over a year out so it will not go to waste if only used for a season, but this would be a good one to use all year. My makeup covered it nicely, as well. I would recommend this sunscreen to others.

avis.titre: The Ultimate Sunscreen for Everyday Protection!
avis.texte: I recently started using the Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60, and I am absolutely thrilled with it! This sunscreen has quickly become a must-have in my daily skincare routine. Exceptional Sun Protection: With SPF 60, I feel completely confident in my skin's protection from harmful UV rays. The high level of protection is ideal for daily wear, especially with my active lifestyle and frequent outdoor activities. I love that it defends against both UVA and UVB rays, which is crucial for preventing premature aging and skin damage. Lightweight and Non-Greasy: One of the standout features of this sunscreen is its lightweight texture. It applies smoothly and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or heavy feel. I've tried many sunscreens that feel sticky or suffocating on the skin, but this one is different! It feels almost like a moisturizer, making it perfect for layering under makeup. Hydration Boost: I was pleasantly surprised by how hydrating this sunscreen is. It contains ingredients that help keep my skin moisturized throughout the day, preventing that tight feeling that can come with some sunscreens. My skin feels soft and supple, which is a huge bonus! Skin Benefits: I've also noticed that this sunscreen helps improve the overall texture of my skin. It seems to even out my tone and leaves a subtle, healthy glow. It's great knowing I'm not only protecting my skin but also supporting its health with a product designed for daily use. Overall Impression: The Capi

I was surprised by this sunscreen because it comes out white, but it melts perfectly into your skin while leaving you hydrated. I'm all about clean ingredients and this one doesn't have anything toxic in it. 👍
Love this product nice feeling and super nice smell will pur have this in the future . Would definitely recommend

I travel alot and always on a hunt for a good face sunscreen. I love this one! Doesn't leave a white cast absorbs great not greasy or oily just perfect. I get bad malasma and this stuff is amazing protects me and improves my skin. I've been noticing my skin looking better after a week of using it. This is going with me on every trip and at home.
This sunscreen is absolutely amazing. Love how easy it is to put on and goes on so nice and no cakey. And I love that it's a really high SPF!
